Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store

package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.store
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    au.csiro.pathling.terminology
     
  • Class
    Description
    CodeSystemStageLoader
    Reads a CodeSystem's staging files through Spark and writes the store tables.
    CodeSystemStaging
    Manages the transient NDJSON staging files produced while streaming one CodeSystem to disk.
    CodeSystemStreamFlattener
    Walks the Jackson token stream of a single FHIR CodeSystem, transcoding its concepts, designations, scalar and Coding-valued properties, and nesting-derived is-a edges into staging rows.
    DefaultDialect
    Chooses the language reference set whose preferred synonyms become the stored display of every concept in a release, and which therefore answers any query that names no dialect the store can serve.
    DenseIdOrder
    The rule an import uses to assign dense identifiers to concepts.
    DenseIdPreOrder
    Computes a depth-first pre-order over a concept hierarchy, expressed as a permutation of dense identifiers.
    FhirResourceScanner
    Streams each FHIR resource in a source just far enough to read its leading metadata ( resourceType, url, version) and byte size, stopping before any large content array.
    FhirTerminologyImporter
    Imports FHIR R4 CodeSystem, ValueSet, and ConceptMap resources into the terminology store.
    ManifestEntry
    One entry of the store manifest, describing an imported code system, value set or concept map and carrying the store format version.
    ScannedResource
    The cheap structural facts about a single FHIR resource, gathered by the streaming pre-scan before any content is written.
    SnomedRf2Importer
    Imports a SNOMED CT RF2 snapshot release into the terminology store.
    TerminologyImportException
    Thrown when a terminology import fails because its source is invalid: a SNOMED CT release that is not a snapshot, an RF2 file with unexpected columns, or a FHIR resource that is not an importable R4 CodeSystem, ValueSet, or ConceptMap.
    TerminologyStoreException
    Thrown when a terminology store cannot be opened or read: the path does not exist, the manifest is missing or unreadable, or the store's format version is newer than this reader understands.
    TerminologyStoreReader
    Reads a terminology store on executors through the Hadoop FileSystem API using Delta Kernel, with no Spark dependency at query time.
    TerminologyStoreRow
    A read-only, column-name addressable view over a single row read from a terminology store table.
    TerminologyStoreSchema
    Defines the on-disk layout of the terminology store: the store format version, the names of the Delta tables, and the schema of the manifest.
    TerminologyStoreWriter
    Writes terminology store tables using Spark and Delta Lake.
    TransitiveClosureBuilder
    Computes the transitive closure of a concept hierarchy at import time using iterative Spark self-joins (the semi-naive algorithm).
